purpose: The Fraud Scoring Service evaluates every payment event in near real time and writes a decision of allow, review or block.

components.name: payment-events
components.evidence: the input topic carrying one event per payment together with customer attributes

components.name: scoring-engine
components.evidence: the service that reads each event, applies rules and a model, and produces a decision

components.name: decisions-db
components.evidence: the datastore for decisions and the customer attributes that were scored

components.name: scoring audit log group
components.evidence: which receives an audit record for each decision
